note: Tests that the agent saves a stable deployment identifier with remember_fact when it discovers one. The remember_fact tool is included as a scripted tool so the system prompt includes the memory rule. The agent should list schemas, find the 'Acme Customer Profile' schema id, and save it.
request: What is the $id of the Acme Customer Profile XDM schema? Save it to memory so future runs don't have to look it up.

tools.name: adobe_list_schemas
tools.description: List XDM schema definitions in the configured AEP sandbox.

tools.name: remember_fact
tools.description: Save a stable deployment fact for future runs, e.g. key "aep.prod_sandbox", value "prod". Overwrites the same key. Only identifiers you verified with a tool; never credentials or personal data. Lowercase key with letters, digits, "_", "." or "-".

criteria: The answer confirms the identifier was saved to memory with remember_fact.
